_help: Manual screen statuses. Key = feature/ScreenName (as shown on the site). status: in-dev | developed | tested | finalized | frozen. 'since' (YYYY-MM-DD) is used to warn when a frozen screen is modified afterwards. Screens not listed get an automatic status. Optional 'issues': [123, 456] links extra open issues to a screen when their title does not contain the screen name.
